title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (back) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session again on Thursday. This was his second-straight of the week, which makes him likely to be available to play for the Jets in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) missed New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young tight end was unable to practice again on Thursday. He continues to deal with a thumb injury of some kind, and it looks like it may leave him sidelined again in Week 4. Rookie Kenyon Sadiq (back) will continue to see more work than usual if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (quad) on side with trainers Thursday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw (quad) was practicing off to the side with trainers on Thursday.
items.impact: Greenlaw seems to be progressing well in his recovery. He was seen getting some work in at practice on Thursday, though he was relegated to a side field. It remains to be seen whether or not he will play in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Williams (stinger) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Trent Williams (stinger) returned to San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Williams was spotted back at practice for the 49ers on Thursday, which is a good sign that he will be available to play in Week 4. His presence would be good news for San Francisco's entire lineup ahead of a tough matchup against the Broncos this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keion White (hamstring) working with trainer Thursday
items.desc: Keion White (hamstring) was off to the side working with a trainer at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was off to the side of San Francisco's practice. He is working with trainers to help rehab from his hamstring injury, and there's a chance that he will be available to play in Week 4. San Francisco's defensive front will look stronger if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (rib) working on side with trainer Thursday
items.desc: Mike Evans (rib) was working off on the side with a trainer at Thursday's practice.
items.impact: Evans was spotted at practice on Thursday, but he was on a side field working with a trainer. It's good to see him participating in some capacity, but we likely won't know more about his Week 4 availability until sometime after practice on Thursday or Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) missed another practice for the Bears on Thursday.
items.impact: Williams was sidelined for another practice on Thursday, which doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he's a long-shot to play in Week 4. Fantasy managers of any Bears players should be gearing up for either Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum to start for Chicago against the Jets this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell is on track to miss a second straight game. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday to end the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Braxton Jones (knee) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Braxton Jones (knee) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was not able to take part in Chicago's practice on Thursday, as he is still dealing with a knee injury that looks likely to leave him sidelined for this week at least. The Bears' offensive front will be weaker than usual if he's unavailable to take the field against the Jets on Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: D'Andre Swift (knee) does not practice Thursday
items.desc: D'Andre Swift (knee) was added to the injury for the Chicago Bears and did not practice Thursday according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Swift's status will need to be monitored during Friday's practice session, as another missed opportunity could leave the running back's status in doubt, with Kyle Monangai in line for increased touches in Week 4 if Swift cannot suit up for head coach Ben Johnson.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Breece Hall remained sidelined from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall remains on track to be sidelined on Sunday against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning/back) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning/back) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Texans, according to HC Brian Schottenheimer.
items.impact: Schottenheimer told reporters that Porter looked good at practice on Friday and that the team is planning on him playing in Week 4. He may very well have a limited snap count after just arriving in Dallas following their recent trade for him, but his presence will still offer a big boost for their defense in this game and beyond.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (back) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Sadiq has logged back-to-back limited practices. He is on track to be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Sam Cosmi (concussion/throat) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Cosmi has already been ruled out for Sunday's game. He's still dealing with a pair of issues and could end up missing more time beyond this game because of them. Washington's offensive line will be weaker than usual while he's out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Sinnott (rib) considered limited Thursday
items.desc: Ben Sinnott (rib) was considered a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Sinnott is still dealing with a rib issue of some kind and was a limited participant on Thursday again as a result. He isn't expected to be fantasy relevant moving forward, however, regardless of whether or not he is healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okonkwo seems to be drawing close to a return to the lineup, as he has been a limited participant at practice all week so far after missing some time due to a hamstring injury. His return would mean less work for Ben Sinnott (rib) and John Bates moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Frankie Luvu (groin) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Frankie Luvu (groin) was a limited participant for the Commanders on Thursday.
items.impact: Luvu's status for Week 4 remains up in the air. He has been limited at practice all week, as he is still dealing with the effects of a nagging groin issue. Washington's defense will be strengthened this week if he's available to play against the Colts on Sunday morning.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Jayden Daniels (elbow) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Daniels was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to rehab an elbow injury that he suffered in Week 2. He doesn't look likely to play in Week 4, but we won't have official word on his status until sometime after practice on Friday probably.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) not spotted at practice Thursday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) was not spotted at Minnesota's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jefferson was not seen during the portion of practice open to the media on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice with an ankle injury. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the rest of the week, as it looks like the star wideout has a real shot of being sidelined against the Dolphins this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darren Waller (rest) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Darren Waller (rest) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The Panthers gave the veteran Wednesday off as a rest day, but he was back at practice on Thursday and participated in a full capacity. He should be a full go for this week's matchup against the Detroit Lions on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (rest) a full participant Thursday
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard (rest) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hubbard was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday, which was the expectation from the start. He should be a full go for Week 4 and remains a must-start fantasy option at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bryce Young (knee) practices in full again Thursday
items.desc: Bryce Young (knee) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Young is still listed on Carolina's injury report due to a knee issue of some kind, but it's not considered serious and hasn't prevented him from practicing in full all week so far. Look for him to play without limitations in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Monroe Freeling (concussion) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Monroe Freeling (concussion) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Freeling missed the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday due to a concussion, but he seems to be progressing well with it and was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday. He may very well play in Week 4, which would be great news for Carolina's offense ahead of a matchup against the Lions.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Xavier Legette (knee) didn't take part in Carolina's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Legette was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a knee injury. It looks like he is going to be sidelined in Week 4 as a result, which will open the door for Brycen Tremayne and Darren Waller to see more work in his likely absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Coker (quad) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Coker was upgraded to a limited participant on Thursday after being a non-participant on Wednesday. That's a big step in the right direction for his Week 4 availability, and we should get an official injury designation for him sometime after practice on Friday. He should be considered startable if he's cleared to play without limitations on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) expected to log full practice Thursday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) is expected to log a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Nacua was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, and it seems like the team was impressed with how he looked, as he is expected to be upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. This is a great sign for his Week 4 availability, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status throughout the week, as the team still may choose to let him sit out in Week 4 out of an abundance of caution.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (back) likely to play Sunday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (back) is expected to suit up and play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Jackson has been dealing with a back injury throughout the week at practice, but it's not considered a serious issue and he is likely to play through it on Sunday against the Titans. Fantasy managers should have no hesitations starting him if he's cleared to play prior to game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Natrone Brooks signing with Vikings practice squad
items.desc: Natrone Brooks is signing a deal to join the Vikings as a member of their practice squad.
items.impact: The Vikings are making a move to shore up their secondary depth, signing Brooks to their practice squad after he was recently released by the Lions. He isn't expected to see the field much for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zack Baun (concussion) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Zack Baun (concussion) was absent from Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and isn't practicing on Thursday as a result. He seems like a long-shot to play in Week 4, and if he's ruled out, Philadelphia's defense will be weaker than usual ahead of a tough matchup against the Rams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) not at practice Thursday
items.desc: Dallas Goedert (knee) was not seen at Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran tight end was not seen participating in Philadelphia's practice on Thursday. He's still recovering from a knee injury and is likely to miss more time before he's back in the lineup. Zach Ertz will continue to see increased run for however long Goedert remains out moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not at practice Thursday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not at Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout is still dealing with a hamstring injury and is absent for a second-straight practice on Thursday as a result. He will need to practice in some capacity on Friday if he wants a realistic chance to play in Week 4, so this is a situation that fantasy managers should keep close tabs on over the next couple of days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) expected to play Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey is expected to play on Thursday against the Browns.
items.impact: Ramsey remains listed as questionable. He is expected to play through a broken wrist.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rakeem Nunez-Roches Sr. (ankle) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Rakeem Nunez-Roches Sr. was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Nunez-Roches missed practice to open the week on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored on the injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Trotter was limited to open the week on Wednesday. He is on track to be good to go on Sunday against the Packers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving (glute) practices Thursday
items.desc: Bucky Irving practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Irving was limited in practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains on track to be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacob Parrish (personal) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Jacob Parrish did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Parrish remained absent due to personal reasons. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dulin missed practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyrone Tracy Jr. was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tracy was sidelined from practice to open the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thomas misses a second straight practice. He'll have to be monitored at practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) designated to return to practice
items.desc: The Seahawks designated Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.impact: Charbonnet will have his 21-day practice window opened up. He won't return this week, but he'll have a chance to return in Week 5 or 6.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) practices Thursday
items.desc: Nico Collins practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins logged a limited practice to open the week on Wednesday. With back-to-back practices, he appears to be on track to returning this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) practicing in full for Week 4
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. is practicing in full for Week 4 against the 49ers.
items.impact: Mims had not practiced since going down with a foot injury in Week 1. He'll be good to return this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) has 'pretty good chance' to return in Week 5
items.desc: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports there is a "pretty good chance" Rico Dowdle returns in Week 5 against the Colts.
items.impact: Dowdle was ruled out for Thursday's game against the Browns. He'll miss a second straight game with Jaylen Warren continuing to lead the Steelers backfield in his place.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Rachaad White did not practice Thursday.
items.impact: White opens the week missing back-to-back practices. Austin Ekeler could be ready for his debut with Washington after signing with them this week.
